name: Aryan Resistance Movement
description: The Aryan Resistance Movement is a small white supremacist prison gang primarily based in Pennsylvania. It was founded in the late 1990s by Tony Adams and Michael Holdridge. No further operational details, membership estimates, colors, or symbols are documented in the available sources.
